comment: Overhead electric lines exist on existing conditions survey and are shown on proposed site plan along western and southern property boundaries. However, no clearance dimension annotations are provided showing the horizontal sky-to-ground distance from the outside conductor to any building faces. Surveyed conductor locations and dimensions are required to verify 7.5-foot minimum clearance.
applicableAreas: Buildings 1-8 near overhead electric lines

comment: Overhead distribution facilities are shown on site plan, but no clearance dimension annotations demonstrate that customer facilities (buildings, structures) maintain the minimum 15-foot radial clearance from the outside conductor of primary and neutral conductors. Surveyed conductor locations are required.
applicableAreas: Buildings 1-8 and site features near overhead distribution conductors

comment: No building elevation sheets or section views are provided showing building projections (overhangs, awnings, balconies, decks, roofs) in relation to overhead electric conductors. Without these exhibits, the required 7.5-foot sky-to-ground and 15-foot radial clearances for projections cannot be verified.
applicableAreas: Building projections (overhangs, balconies, roofs)

comment: Overhead electric facilities exist in the Valley View Road right-of-way adjacent to the site. Buildings are proposed adjacent to this ROW, but no clearance dimension annotations demonstrate maintenance of the minimum 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground and 15-foot radial clearances from these ROW facilities.
applicableAreas: Buildings near Valley View Road right-of-way with adjacent overhead electric facilities

comment: No building elevation sheets with surveyed elevations and locations of overhead conductors are included in the site plan package. Code requires registered surveyor data showing conductor elevations to verify that required clearances from buildings are met.
applicableAreas: All buildings within potential clearance distance of overhead electric facilities

comment: Section and plan view exhibits with dimension annotations from outer electric conductor to building edges and projections are not provided. Code requires dimensioned clearance exhibits showing the measurement from outside conductor to outermost extent of buildings and projections.
applicableAreas: Buildings and building projections within potential clearance distance of overhead electric conductors

comment: Fences are proposed on site plan, and overhead electric lines exist. However, no clearance dimension annotations demonstrate that fences maintain the minimum 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from the outside conductor.
applicableAreas: Fences along property boundaries and site perimeter

comment: Existing utility poles are shown on the existing conditions survey. Proposed fences are shown on site plan. However, no dimension annotations show the horizontal clearance distance from fence post locations to existing electric poles. Code requires minimum 10-foot clearance.
applicableAreas: Fence post locations relative to existing utility poles

comment: Retaining walls are shown on grading and wall plan sheets. Overhead electric lines are shown on existing conditions and site plan. However, no clearance dimension annotations demonstrate that retaining walls maintain the minimum 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from the outermost electric line.
applicableAreas: Retaining walls located near overhead electric facilities

comment: Section exhibits are provided for retaining walls (Sheets 38-39), but they do not include dimension annotations showing clearance distances from the outer electric conductor to the outermost edge of the walls. Code requires dimensioned section exhibits demonstrating clearance compliance.
applicableAreas: Retaining walls within potential clearance distance of overhead electric facilities

comment: Driveways are proposed on the site plan, and overhead electric lines exist. However, no vertical clearance dimension annotations are provided showing the clearance from the lowest point of the overhead facilities to finished driveway grades. Code requires 16 feet minimum (parking without truck traffic) or 18 feet (areas with truck traffic). Mid-span clearance verification from registered surveyor is not provided.
applicableAreas: Driveways and parking areas potentially beneath or adjacent to overhead electric facilities

comment: Vehicle parking areas are proposed on site plan, and overhead electric lines are present. However, no vertical clearance dimension annotations are shown from the lowest point of overhead facilities to parking areas. Code requires compliance with clearance requirements (minimum 12-18 feet depending on use).
applicableAreas: Vehicle parking areas beneath or adjacent to overhead electric lines

comment: Existing electric poles are shown on existing conditions survey. Proposed driveways are shown on site plan. However, no dimension annotations demonstrate the horizontal distance from driveway edges to existing poles, and no notes indicate whether poles will be relocated minimum 30 feet from driveway edges.
applicableAreas: Driveways and site features in proximity to existing electric poles

comment: Overhead electric lines and utility poles are shown on the site plan, but NO clearance dimensions are annotated on any sheets (site plan, grading plan, or other exhibits). When clearance dimensions are eventually provided, they must be measured from the outside conductor, not from pole centerline or pole structure. Code requires dimensions originating from conductor location.
applicableAreas: All site features and overhead electric facilities where clearances apply

comment: Trash enclosure locations are shown on site plan. Overhead electric lines are present. However, no clearance dimension annotations demonstrate that trash enclosures maintain the required 7.5-foot sky-to-ground clearance considering trash bin raised height during service.
applicableAreas: Trash enclosure and receptacle locations

comment: Overhead distribution facilities are shown on site plan. While buildings appear positioned away from direct conflict based on visual spacing, the lack of surveyed conductor locations and explicit dimensional evidence means that compliance with the absolute prohibition against installing customer facilities under or over overhead distribution facilities cannot be conclusively verified.
applicableAreas: Buildings, structures, and site features within or beneath existing overhead distribution facilities

comment: Water meter locations are shown on the electrical design plan (Sheet 21). However, no clearance dimension annotations demonstrate that water meters maintain the minimum 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from overhead electric service-drop conductors.
applicableAreas: Water meter locations relative to overhead electric service drops

comment: Water lines are shown on utility plans. Overhead distribution lines are shown on site plan. However, no clearance dimension annotations demonstrate that water lines maintain required clearances from overhead distribution facilities.
applicableAreas: Water line routing beneath or adjacent to overhead electrical distribution facilities

comment: Building foundations are shown on site plan, some within or near 5-foot distance from property lines where electric facilities may be required in adjacent ROW or property. However, no dimension annotations show the clearance space from property line to building foundation to verify that adequate room exists for necessary electric facility maintenance and access.
applicableAreas: Building foundations within 5 feet of property line

comment: No registered surveyor data showing pole locations and mid-span clearances is provided in the site plan package. Code requires surveyor-certified mid-span clearance verification when existing overhead facilities may not meet minimum vertical clearance requirements (7.5-foot sky-to-ground, 16-18 feet for driveways). Without this data, vertical clearances cannot be verified.
applicableAreas: All site features where overhead facilities may not meet minimum vertical clearance requirements

comment: Overhead electric lines cross Valley View Road at the site property boundary. However, no angle dimension annotation demonstrates that the crossing is oriented at 90-degree angle to the road centerline as required.
applicableAreas: Overhead electric line crossings of Valley View Road

comment: Trees are proposed on the landscape plan (Sheet 31) within what appears to be 10 lateral feet of overhead distribution conductors based on visual spacing and symbol overlap. However, the specific species of these proposed trees are not identified on the landscape plan. Tree species verification against ECM Appendix F Utility Compatible trees list (generally mature height ≤20 feet) cannot be performed without this information.
applicableAreas: Landscape areas along southern and western property boundaries adjacent to overhead distribution conductors

comment: Meter locations are shown on electrical plan (Sheet 21). However, no detailed site plan or meter area enlargement is provided showing working clearances around meter locations. Code requires 30-inch-wide front space, 36-inch front depth, and 6.5-foot headroom per UCM § 1.10.9, free of obstructions including fences, walls, equipment, vegetation, and building projections.
applicableAreas: Electric meter locations and meter equipment clearances

comment: Existing conditions survey (Sheet 4) shows down guy wires (e.g., AT&T pole with guy wire shown). However, proposed site plan does not clearly depict existing down guy wire locations, and there are no notes indicating whether conflicts with proposed accessible paths, driveways, or site features have been identified and resolved through pole relocation or conversion to self-supporting poles.
applicableAreas: Down guy wire locations from existing electric poles

comment: Down guy anchors are visible on existing conditions survey (utilities shown with guy wires). However, no down guy anchor easements are depicted on the easement exhibits or site plan. Code requires dedicated easements 10 feet wide extending 5 feet past where down guy enters the ground. Without easement depiction, the requirement cannot be verified.
applicableAreas: Down guy anchor points from existing electric poles

comment: Overhead electric lines exist on and adjacent to the site. Construction activities are proposed. However, no construction staging plan, site logistics plan, or phasing plan is provided in the submitted site plan package showing construction staging area boundaries, crane swing radius, or material storage locations relative to overhead electric lines. Code requires 10-foot radial clearance from energized overhead lines for construction activities.
applicableAreas: Construction staging areas, equipment operation zones, and work platforms

comment: Overhead electric lines exist on site and construction activities are proposed. However, no note is provided on the cover sheet or general notes requiring that the owner/contractor notify Austin Energy at least 48 hours before work begins near high-voltage overhead lines, as required by Texas Health & Safety Code Chapter 752, Section 752.003.
applicableAreas: Cover sheet and general notes for construction phase notifications

comment: Landscape plan shows trees (mitigation trees and existing trees) located directly adjacent to or overlapping the OHE line along the southern boundary. Plant schedule does not identify utility-compatible status per ECM Appendix F UC column for any of the proposed trees (Live Oak, Cedar Elm, Mexican Redbud). Without documented utility compatibility designation and without clearance dimensions on the plans, compliance cannot be verified.
applicableAreas: Southern property boundary where OHE line is located
Street yard area where trees are proposed

comment: Landscape plan shows shade trees (Live Oak and Cedar Elm, each with minimum 16-foot planting specification) proposed near the OHE line on the southern boundary. However, plant schedule does not specify mature heights per ECM Appendix F, which is required to determine if trees qualify as 'large' (40+ feet mature height) subject to the 25-foot clearance requirement from distribution conductors. Mature height from ECM Appendix F cannot be verified.
applicableAreas: Southern property boundary where OHE line is located
Street yard areas where shade trees are proposed

comment: Overhead electric poles are present along the OHE line (shown on Sheet 21 and Sheet 31). Trees are shown on the landscape plan in proximity to these utility areas. However, the landscape plan does not dimension the clearance distances between individual trees and specific poles. Without clearance dimensions, the 10-foot minimum separation requirement cannot be verified.
applicableAreas: Overhead electric line along southern and western property boundaries where utility poles are located

comment: Sheet 21 electrical design plan shows a pad-mounted transformer in the western street yard area. Sheet 31 landscape plan shows a street yard tree (marked SY) in the same general area with the tree's canopy circle drawn extremely close to or overlapping the transformer pad. No clearance dimension is provided. Minimum 10-foot clearance from tree trunk to pad-mounted equipment cannot be verified from available evidence.
applicableAreas: Street yard area on western side where electrical transformer pad is located

comment: Underground electric lines are shown on the landscape plan (marked as '- E -' on Sheet 31). However, the specific locations of underground electric equipment (pull boxes, vaults, buried transformers, etc.) are not clearly identified on the landscape plan. Without identified equipment locations and without dimensioned clearances, the 5-foot minimum clearance requirement cannot be verified.
applicableAreas: Areas where underground electric lines and equipment are located

comment: Underground electric equipment locations are not clearly identified on the landscape plan. Therefore, it cannot be determined which proposed trees fall within the 20-foot proximity zone requiring root barriers. Additionally, no root barrier specifications are shown on the landscape plan or in the landscape notes. Without identified equipment locations and without documented root barrier specifications, compliance cannot be verified.
applicableAreas: Areas where trees are proposed within 20 lateral feet of underground electric equipment

comment: Landscape plan (Sheet 31) and plant schedule (Sheet 35) do not differentiate large trees (mature height 40+ feet per ECM Appendix F) from smaller species. The plant schedule shows only minimum planting specifications (16' for Live Oak and Cedar Elm) without reference to their ECM Appendix F mature height classifications. Without this designation, it is not possible to verify whether clearance requirements for large trees near overhead facilities are being met.
applicableAreas: All proposed tree planting areas, particularly near overhead electric facilities

comment: While the landscape plan does show the OHE utility line and trees in relation to it (both are depicted on Sheet 31), the plan fails to demonstrate compliance because no clearance dimensions are provided between tree trunk centers and the conductor line. Trees shown with canopies overlapping the OHE line position lack any dimensioned clearance verification. Reviewer cannot verify clearance compliance from the presented evidence.
applicableAreas: Southern boundary where OHE line runs parallel to property line
Street yard areas where trees are in proximity to utility facilities

comment: The landscape plan shows trees positioned adjacent to or overlapping the OHE line along the southern boundary and near the transformer pad in the street yard, but no documented written approval from Austin Energy is included in the submitted plans or supplementary documents authorizing these tree placements within the restricted electrical clearance zones. Without such approval, trees in these proximity zones constitute a regulatory violation.
applicableAreas: Trees proposed in proximity to overhead electric facilities and pad-mounted equipment

comment: Transformer pad locations are identified on the electrical plan, but no dimensions are provided showing clearances to buildings. Applicant must provide dimensioned site plan showing minimum 5-foot clearance from edge of transformer pad to all building footprints and structures.
applicableAreas: all transformer pad locations

comment: Retaining walls are present on site but clearance distances from transformer pads are not dimensioned. Provide dimensioned plan showing minimum 5-foot clearance from transformer pad edges to all retaining wall structures.
applicableAreas: retaining walls on north, east, south site boundaries and detention pond perimeter

comment: No cross-section drawings or building elevation details provided showing vertical clearances from transformer pads to building balconies, overhangs, or structures. Provide architectural cross-sections for each transformer location demonstrating minimum 5-foot lateral clearance from balconies/overhangs and confirmation that no structures cover pad areas.
applicableAreas: all transformer pad locations

comment: Building elevation drawings are not provided. Applicant must submit: (1) building elevation details showing all windows, doors, and ventilating ducts adjacent to transformer locations; (2) confirmation of oil-filled vs. dry-type equipment; (3) dimensional clearance analysis demonstrating 12-foot horizontal clearance when lateral separation is less than 5 feet or when openings are less than 12 feet from grade.
applicableAreas: all transformer pad locations

comment: Sidewalk locations are shown on site plan but clearance distances to transformer pads are not dimensioned. Provide dimensioned plan showing minimum 2-foot clearance from back of sidewalk to transformer pad edges at all locations where sidewalks are adjacent to transformer pads.
applicableAreas: transformer pad locations near sidewalk systems

comment: Transformer pad equipment specifications, access door orientations, and clearance dimensions are not provided on the electrical plan. Applicant must provide: (1) Austin Energy Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets identifying access door location; (2) dimensioned site plan showing minimum 10-foot clearance from access door side to adjacent open areas or structures.
applicableAreas: all transformer pad locations

comment: No cross-section drawings are provided showing vertical clearances in areas with building overhangs, enclosed configurations, or notched-out areas adjacent to transformer locations. Provide cross-section drawings for any transformer location adjacent to building elements that might create a confined space configuration requiring 15-foot hot-stick clearance and 35-foot vertical clearance in niche.
applicableAreas: transformer pad locations

comment: Fire hydrant location and transformer pad location are identified but clearance distance is not dimensioned. Provide dimensioned plan showing minimum 5-foot clearance from transformer pad edges to fire hydrant structure.
applicableAreas: east-central transformer pad area between Buildings 4, 5, and 7

comment: Landscape plan shows mitigation trees and landscaping areas but does not identify specific proposed tree species or provide utility-compatible designations per ECM Appendix F. Applicant must submit proposed planting schedule listing all tree species (botanical and common names) with verification that species within 10 lateral feet of transformer pads are ECM Appendix F utility-compatible ('UC' designation).
applicableAreas: all transformer pad locations where proposed landscaping is within 10 feet

comment: Landscape plan shows vegetation areas but does not dimension shrub and low-lying vegetation clearances to transformer pads. Applicant must provide: (1) equipment detail sheets showing access door orientation on each transformer pad; (2) dimensioned landscape plan showing minimum 10-foot clearance from access door side and minimum 5-foot clearance from other sides to all proposed shrubs and low-lying vegetation.
applicableAreas: landscaping areas adjacent to transformer pads

comment: No root barrier details are shown on landscape or construction detail sheets. Applicant must provide root barrier detail sheets showing minimum 4-foot depth and 5-foot offset from underground electrical equipment for all trees within 20 lateral feet of transformer pads and underground electrical routing.
applicableAreas: trees within 20 lateral feet of underground electrical equipment

comment: Light pole locations are not specifically dimensioned relative to transformer pads on the site plan. Applicant must provide photometric plan or lighting detail sheets showing all light pole locations and dimensions demonstrating minimum 5-foot clearance to transformer pad edges.
applicableAreas: transformer pad locations

comment: Fire lanes are not specifically delineated or dimensioned on the fire protection plan relative to transformer pad locations. Applicant must identify which internal driveways are designated fire lanes and provide dimensioned plan showing minimum 15-foot clearance from transformer pad edges to fire lane boundaries.
applicableAreas: all transformer pad locations

comment: Four transformer pads are shown on the electrical plan but no clearance dimensions are provided between any of them. Applicant must provide dimensioned plan showing minimum 5-foot clearance between each transformer pad pair.
applicableAreas: all transformer pad locations

comment: Water lines are routed directly adjacent to transformer pad edges at multiple locations, providing insufficient clearance. Relocate water lines to maintain minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance from all transformer pad edges, or relocate transformer pads to maintain clearance. Provide dimensioned utility coordination plan showing all water lines at minimum 5 feet from transformer pad perimeters.
applicableAreas: west-central transformer pad (west of Building 2); east-central transformer pad (south of Building 5, east of Building 7)

comment: Wastewater line routes are shown but clearance dimensions to transformer pads are not provided. Applicant must provide dimensioned utility coordination plan showing minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance from wastewater lines to all transformer pad edges.
applicableAreas: transformer pad locations near wastewater infrastructure

comment: Storm drain line routes are shown but clearance dimensions to transformer pads are not provided. Applicant must provide dimensioned utility coordination plan showing minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance from storm drain lines to all transformer pad edges.
applicableAreas: transformer pad locations

comment: Utility line routing is shown in plan view but specific horizontal and vertical clearance dimensions are not provided. Applicant must provide detailed utility coordination drawing showing all existing and proposed utilities with specific measurements (horizontal and vertical) demonstrating minimum 12-inch clearance from transformer pad and underground electrical infrastructure to all other utilities.
applicableAreas: transformer pad and underground electrical routing

comment: Utility coordination shown in plan view only without vertical component (inverts, depths, cross-sections). Applicant must provide detailed vertical utility coordination showing all utilities with invert elevations, pipe depths, and cross-section drawings demonstrating that no transformer pads or underground electrical facilities are located over or under other utility lines, and that no building foundations or structures will be installed over electrical facilities.
applicableAreas: transformer pad and electrical routing relative to all underground utilities

comment: No cross-section drawings are provided showing vertical clearances from transformer pad locations to overhead structures, building overhangs, or parking garage slabs. Applicant must provide cross-section drawings for each transformer location (taken perpendicular to and through the transformer pad) showing vertical clearances to any overhead building elements, parking structures, or enclosed areas.
applicableAreas: all transformer pad locations, particularly those adjacent to buildings with parking garages or overhangs

comment: Oil-filled vs. dry-type equipment not specified on electrical plan. Detailed grading around transformer pads not provided. Applicant must: (1) confirm whether equipment will be oil-filled or dry-type; (2) if oil-filled, provide detailed grading and drainage plan showing surface slopes around each transformer pad directing liquid flow away from adjacent buildings.
applicableAreas: all oil-filled transformer pad locations

comment: Transformer pad locations relative to easement boundaries are not clearly dimensioned or verified. Facts.md documents two critical undepicted easements in NE area that must be added to site plan before approval. Applicant must: (1) clearly show all easement boundaries on electrical plan with transformer locations dimensioned relative to easement edges; (2) confirm no transformer pads are located in drainage, water, sewer, or electrical easements, or provide Austin Energy Design written approval for any proposed locations; (3) add missing greenbelt access easement and drainage easement to site plan exhibits.
applicableAreas: all transformer pad locations relative to documented and undocumented easements

comment: No transformer easements are shown on any submitted plan sheet. Applicant must provide easement exhibit showing transformer easements of adequate width around all four transformer pad locations. Submit Austin Energy Design specifications for required easement width and coordinate with AE Design business unit for appropriate easement configuration and recording requirements.
applicableAreas: all four transformer pad locations

comment: Complete electrical routing from transformers to service meters is not clearly shown or verified to be 100% on private property. Applicant must provide detailed electrical routing plan with property boundary overlay showing the complete path from each transformer pad to its corresponding building service meter, confirming all routing remains on private property and outside public right-of-way and utility easements.
applicableAreas: electrical routing from all transformer pads to building service meters

comment: No transformer pad dimensions are shown on any submitted plan or detail sheet, and no Austin Energy Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets are included. Applicant must obtain from Austin Energy Design the transformer pad detail sheets corresponding to the specified service type (single-phase or three-phase) and provide: (1) dimensioned pad configuration details; (2) equipment specifications including transformer ratings and pad dimensions; (3) confirmation of compliance with AE Design requirements; (4) reference callouts on electrical plan sheet 21 to applicable AE Design standard details.
applicableAreas: all four transformer pads

comment: West-central transformer pad is positioned between building and parking aisle. No dimensions are provided showing clearance to parking area. No bollards are detailed. Applicant must either: (1) provide dimensioned plan showing transformer pad is more than 4 feet from parking area edge, OR (2) provide AE Design equipment pad detail sheets with 4-inch diameter galvanized rigid metal bollard specifications and site plan showing bollard placement and spacing to allow equipment door opening.
applicableAreas: west-central transformer pad (west of Building 2)
